scenario.title: Short · Two courier quotations
scenario.brief: Select the lowest-cost feasible quote to deliver 40 replacement sensors from our Lyon warehouse to our Paris service centre. The complete shipment must arrive by the stated deadline and insurance must be included. These are fictional quotations for an academic experiment; treat their listed amounts and dates as the supplied facts.

options.terms: The quoted total covers collection, road transport, delivery, and transit insurance. Collection is at the Lyon warehouse loading bay; delivery is to the Paris service centre receiving desk. The service handles all 40 units as one consignment.

The economy service consolidates the consignment with other deliveries. The quotation includes collection and insurance. Its listed arrival date is fixed for this exercise; do not assume it can be expedited at the same price.

configuration.validation_scope: Exact Python-supported claims and canonical decision reasoning. Original narrative quality is not certified.

calls.system_prompt: You are the Ingestion quotation reviewer. Return at most TWO relevant claims. For example, quote_id="S1", constraint="within_budget" requires explanation="S1: within_budget=PASS." Substitute the actual quote ID, constraint and uppercase result from each claim. Never output placeholder names. Use only Python comparisons. Do not add numeric prose. Prefer uncertainties=[]; otherwise copy a protected source caveat exactly. Return only JSON matching the provided schema, with claims and uncertainties arrays. Every factual comparison must be a claim with the exact supplied quote_id, a constraint from within_budget, on_time, enough_capacity, insured_as_required, eligible, lowest_cost_eligible, result pass/fail/unknown, and a short explanation. Use Python calculations as authoritative. Each explanation or uncertainty must be at most 30 words. State missing evidence explicitly; never interpret unknown as pass. Use at most 12 relevant claims and 6 uncertainties. Do not duplicate a quote/constraint pair. An uncertainty has quote_id (null only for a general issue) and detail. Use empty arrays when no relevant claims or uncertainties exist. No Markdown or extra fields.
